region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis medication-list screen program HCM1PL01 (map HCM1MAP): first entry sends the screen and then falls into RECEIVE MAP; ENTER LINKs HCP1BI01 for the patient name and HCM1BI01 (with HCIMDB01) for the medication rows; PF3, PF12, CLEAR, PF7/PF8 and MAPFAIL take their HANDLE AID / HANDLE CONDITION arms. A patient with two or more MEDICATION rows is not driven: HCM1BI01's LOAD-COMMAREA stores entry n after setting CA-NUM-MEDICATIONS to n-1, a subscript past the ODO count that IBM (no SSRANGE) leaves undefined and GnuCOBOL refuses (register X8), so the CA-NUM-MEDICATIONS > 1 and > 2 arms are not reachable here. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. The terminal is stated as T001 (a deployment fact; RETURN TRANSID IMMEDIATE needs one, register X27).

scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: INITIALIZE the map and areas, SEND HCM1MAP with ERASE, then fall into RECEIVE MAP, which raises MAPFAIL (no input): HANDLE CONDITION sends ENDIT

scenarios.name: list-one-medication
scenarios.why: patient 3 has one MEDICATION row: HCP1BI01 gives the name, HCM1BI01 returns one entry, the first medication line is filled and the map is sent, then RETURN TRANSID HCM1

scenarios.name: patient-without-medication
scenarios.why: patient 1 exists but has no MEDICATION row: HCM1BI01 returns '01', NO-MED-DATA sends 'No medication data was returned.'

scenarios.name: unknown-patient
scenarios.why: patient 99 does not exist: HCP1BI01 returns '01' (SQLCODE +100), NO-PATIENT-DATA sends 'No patient data was returned.'

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF3: ENDIT sends 'Transaction ended'

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF12: CANCELIT RETURNs TRANSID HCAZ IMMEDIATE

scenarios.name: pf7
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF7: NOT-IMPLEMENTED sends 'That feature has not been implemented yet.'

scenarios.name: pf8
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID PF8: NOT-IMPLEMENTED, same arm as PF7 under its own key

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: HANDLE AID CLEAR: the map is resent MAPONLY, then RETURN TRANSID HCM1

scenarios.name: enter-no-map-received
scenarios.why: RECEIVE MAP raises MAPFAIL: HANDLE CONDITION sends ENDIT
